definitions.gloss: to be balanced; to be well-matched; to be proportionate
definitions.explanation: For two things to be in proper balance or proportion with each other. Often used to describe whether people, things, or amounts are suitably matched.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{釣|つ}り{合|あ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The price and quality are well balanced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{支出|ししゅつ}→支出：03169_shishutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{釣|つ}り{合|あ}わない。
examples.english: Income and expenses don't balance out.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{釣|つ}り{合|あ}った{良|い}い⟦カップル→カップル：19414_kappuru⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think those two are a well-matched couple.

notes:
{釣|つ}り{合|あ}う is an intransitive godan verb. The noun form is ⟦{釣|つ}り{合|あ}い→釣り合い：20575_tsuriai⟧ (balance, proportion).

ASPECT (ている):
{釣|つ}り{合|あ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the state of being in balance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{釣|つ}り{合|あ}う (A and B are balanced)
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{釣|つ}り{合|あ}う (to match/be proportionate to)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{釣|つ}り{合|あ}い→釣り合い：20575_tsuriai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧ (to achieve balance)
- ⟦{釣|つ}り{合|あ}い→釣り合い：20575_tsuriai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れない→取れる：02376_toreru⟧ (to be out of balance)
- ⟦{身分|みぶん}→身分：00278_mibun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{釣|つ}り{合|あ}わない (not befitting one's status)

RELATED WORDS:
{釣|つ}り{合|あ}わぬ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不縁|ふえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと is an old saying meaning "an unequal match leads to a broken relationship."
